description: This file defines a final class ByteBufferInputStream that extends InputStream, providing a way to create an InputStream backed by a ByteBuffer. It includes static factory method 'of' to create instances from ByteBuffer objects and overrides read methods to read data from the ByteBuffer.

classes.name: ByteBufferInputStream
classes.description: Final class extending InputStream, backed by a ByteBuffer, providing stream reading capabilities from the ByteBuffer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an InputStream from the given ByteBuffer. If the ByteBuffer has an accessible backing array, it returns a ByteArrayInputStream; otherwise, it returns a ByteBufferInputStream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Overrides InputStream.read(). Reads a byte from the ByteBuffer, returning it as an int or -1 if no remaining data.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Overrides InputStream.read(byte[], int, int). Reads bytes from the ByteBuffer into the provided array, returning the number of bytes read or -1 if none are available.
